name: manual_b1377b
claim: Do not resolve a review thread involving executable behavior until the exact current head is confirmed green on the affected tests and relevant CI -- a resolved thread's UI state is not proof of correctness, and describing planned validation as if it were completed evidence is a distinct, separate error from the underlying bug

decisions.notes: 2026-09-13, oramasys/orama-system PR #357: four CodeRabbit findings were marked resolved while the exact current head was CI-red on tests the remediation itself had touched. The canonical gate is FINDING -> CURRENT HEAD -> RED PROOF -> MINIMAL FIX -> FOCUSED GREEN -> FULL GREEN -> RE-READ FINDING -> RESOLVE -- each step is a separate fact requiring its own evidence: a conceptually sound fix, a passing new test, an unbroken old test, a green focused file, a green full suite, a green exact-head CI run, and a resolved thread are six distinct claims, and none of the earlier ones proves any of the later ones. Full write-up: .agent/memory/working/ORAMA_PR357_PR_BODY_INTEGRITY_FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_RECOVERY_2026-09-13.md.
